summary_en: W TOKYO establishes shareholder return policy targeting dividend payout ratio of 20% or above. Interim dividend of 20 yen per share (13 yen ordinary plus 7 yen commemorative) for fiscal year ending June 2027, with projected annual dividend of 33 yen including expected 13 yen final dividend. Company discontinues shareholder incentive program from December 31, 2026 onward.
title_en: Notice Regarding Establishment of Shareholder Return Policy, Dividend Payment (Interim Dividend and First Dividend), Revision of Dividend Forecast, and Discontinuation of Shareholder Incentive Program
translation_en_brief:
W TOKYO announced on November 13, 2026 the establishment of a comprehensive shareholder return policy and execution of its first dividend distribution. The company will adopt a dividend payout ratio target of 20% or above, marking a shift from its historical non-dividend practice. The interim dividend for fiscal year ending June 30, 2027 (based on December 31, 2026) totals 20 yen per share, comprising 13 yen in ordinary dividend and 7 yen in commemorative dividend to mark the planned company name change to TGC IP Group effective January 1, 2027. The company projects an additional 13 yen final dividend, bringing the total fiscal year 2027 dividend to 33 yen per share.

The dividend policy represents a fundamental shift in capital allocation strategy. The company will maintain adequate investment capacity for business growth and financial soundness while implementing continuous and stable dividends. Each period's dividend amount will be determined by comprehensively considering business performance, cash flow, financial condition, growth investment opportunities, and operating environment.

Concurrently, W TOKYO will discontinue its shareholder incentive program effective December 31, 2026 onward, except for the program scheduled for June 30, 2026. The company views dividend-centric shareholder returns as more equitable and sustainable than the previous dual approach. The company emphasized that future dividends from fiscal 2028 onward will be determined under the newly established return policy, with announcements made at appropriate times.
